stakeholders.name: Yavet Arimathea Widjaja
stakeholders.interest: Owns market strategy and the seller program; signed 9 of 14 shops in one afternoon. Wants the site to convert Early Adaptor sign-ups and present Mobeeli credibly to investors. Primary decision-maker on copy and design (both already reviewed in the Claude Design project).

stakeholders.name: Muhammad Salman Al Hafizh
stakeholders.interest: Built the fitment engine and marketplace platform pre-funding; cares that the site's tech stack is maintainable and the waitlist data reaches the team reliably.

stakeholders.name: Ferdinansyah Husein
stakeholders.interest: Runs operations and partnerships; follows up waitlist leads personally via WhatsApp/email, so lead capture quality and follow-up channel links matter to him.

stakeholders.name: Parts shops / sellers (Early Adaptors)
stakeholders.role: Primary site audience — stores, garages/workshops, distributors
stakeholders.interest: Want to understand the 0% first-300-shops offer, AI catalog upload, fraud protection, and low flat commission; need a fast Bahasa-Indonesia-first waitlist wizard (many will arrive on mobile via WhatsApp links).

stakeholders.name: Car owners / buyers (Jakarta)
stakeholders.interest: Want to be notified at launch; served by the buyer strip's 'Get notified' action.

stakeholders.name: Investors (SEA commerce infrastructure)
stakeholders.interest: Evaluate traction and team; use the Investors section to request the deck or email founders directly. Copy must invite a look and never say 'raising'.
